item.text:
**8B.9 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador, 2024**

Best read: **mixed but net negative** for this lens. There is real evidence of crisis coordination and de-escalatory diplomacy, but the stronger 2024 pattern is confrontational handling of critics and institutions, especially around judicial reform, the press, and security forces.

| Side | Source | Date | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| Positive | [Declaración conjunta del presidente de México, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, y del presidente de Estados Unidos, Joe Biden](https://www.gob.mx/sre/prensa/declaracion-conjunta-del-presidente-de-mexico-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador-y-del-presidente-de-estados-unidos-joe-biden?idiom=es-MX) | 2024-04-29 | Mexico and the U.S. ordered their security teams to implement immediate measures to reduce irregular border crossings while protecting human rights, which is concrete bilateral crisis-management behavior. | 8B.9 |
| Positive | [“Apoyemos la paz y la fraternidad universal”: presidente; llama al cese al fuego en Medio Oriente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/apoyemos-la-paz-y-la-fraternidad-universal-presidente-llama-al-cese-al-fuego-en-medio-oriente/) | 2024-04-15 | AMLO publicly called for a ceasefire and dialogue in the Middle East and rejected escalation, which is direct de-escalatory crisis rhetoric. | 8B.9 |
| Positive | [Garantizan los tres órdenes de gobierno recursos para recuperación de Acapulco y otros municipios afectados por John](https://www.gob.mx/sspc/prensa/garantizan-los-tres-ordenes-de-gobierno-recursos-para-recuperacion-de-acapulco-y-otros-municipios-afectados-por-john) | 2024-09-28 | After Hurricane John, federal, state, and municipal authorities coordinated evacuations, sheltering, water removal, and recovery resources; this is strong evidence of operational crisis management. | 8B.9 |
| Positive | [Presidente AMLO entregará informe a madres y padres Ayotzinapa con anexos que sustentan cada respuesta](https://www.gob.mx/segob/prensa/presidente-amlo-entregara-informe-a-madres-y-padres-ayotzinapa-con-anexos-que-sustentan-cada-respuesta-370094) | 2024-07-03 | The government said it had conducted searches at 251 sites and would deliver a report to families, showing it kept the Ayotzinapa case open rather than simply closing it by denial. | 8B.9 |
| Positive | [Tribunal Electoral valida elección presidencial: Segob; presidente celebra ejemplar transición en gobierno federal](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/tribunal-electoral-valida-eleccion-presidencial-segob-presidente-celebra-ejemplar-transicion-en-gobierno-federal/) | 2024-08-13 | After the election was validated, AMLO publicly celebrated an “ejemplar transición,” which is direct evidence of procedural acceptance of a successor and the handoff of power. | 8B.9 |
| Positive | [AMLO acepta represión violenta en Veracruz; informa que hay dos policías detenidos](https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html) | 2024-07-16 | AMLO acknowledged police violence against protesters and said two officers were detained; this is a notable restraint/accountability signal in a domestic flare-up. | 8B.9 |
| Negative | [Mexico freezes relations with US, Canadian embassies which criticized judicial reform](https://www.investing.com/news/commodities-news/mexico-to-pause-relationship-with-us-embassy-after-judicial-reform-comments-president-says-3589198) | 2024-08-27 | AMLO paused relations with the U.S. and Canadian embassies after they criticized his judicial reform, showing he sometimes answered external criticism with confrontation rather than compromise. | 8B.9 |
| Negative | [Judicial strikes grow in Mexico over reform pushing currency lower](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judicial-strikes-grow-in-mexico-over-reform-pushing-currency-lower-3581911) | 2024-08-21 | Judges and magistrates joined strikes as protests against the judicial reform intensified; AMLO framed the reform as anti-impunity, but the episode shows major institutional resistance and conflict. | 8B.9 |
| Negative | [Mexican lower house approves controversial judicial reform](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) | 2024-09-15 | Reuters reported the overhaul was enacted despite criticism that it weakened judicial independence and investor confidence, which is strong evidence of rule-changing to preserve governing power. | 8B.9 |
| Negative | [Mexico | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico) | 2024-06-17 | The Reuters Institute documented repeated verbal attacks on journalists and the New York Times phone-number episode, which shows a hostile response to scrutiny rather than routine accommodation of opposition. | 8B.9 |
| Negative | [Mexico: Proposed constitutional changes threaten rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) | 2024-08-30 | Human Rights Watch warned the proposed changes could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards, suggesting institutional resistance was being met by power concentration. | 8B.9 |

**Synthesis**
- The strongest positive material is on **crisis coordination** and **procedural handoff**: border management with the U.S., the Middle East ceasefire statement, Hurricane John response, Ayotzinapa follow-through, and acceptance of the election result.
- The strongest negative material is on **institutional resistance and opposition management**: judicial reform, pauses in diplomatic relations after criticism, hostile treatment of journalists, and the drive to weaken counterweights.
- Net: AMLO in 2024 sometimes managed crises in a way consistent with regime durability, but the broader pattern suggests he often advanced regime objectives by **pressuring institutions and critics**, not by preserving neutral constraints.

**Search gap**
- I found limited direct 2024 evidence on broad external crisis management beyond the U.S. border/migration track and the Middle East ceasefire statement. Most high-quality evidence for this lens is domestic, centered on the judiciary, security forces, and the press.
